title: macroptilium gracile var. subcoriaceum
intro: Macroptilium gracile var. subcoriaceum, commonly known as the wavy bean or kidney bean, is a species of plant in the legume family that is native to Mexico and Central America. Research suggests that this plant has various health benefits, including its potential to help lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Macroptilium gracile var. subcoriaceum include its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating conditions such as fever and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Macroptilium gracile var. subcoriaceum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
